processes.name: CloudFront
processes.description: Serves the React single-page web app to the public internet.
processes.source_excerpt: CloudFront serves it to the public internet over HTTPS with TLS 1.3

processes.name: React single-page web app
processes.description: Public web application that calls the internal Orders API.

processes.name: AWS WAF
processes.description: Limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes on CloudFront.
processes.source_excerpt: AWS WAF on CloudFront limits each client to 2,000 requests per five minutes

processes.name: Orders API
processes.description: Internal API that authenticates requests, reads and writes orders, authorises payments, supports administrator actions, and writes an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database

processes.name: nightly batch job
processes.description: Nightly job that reads at most one day of orders and writes summaries to S3.
processes.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders

processes.name: Athena
processes.description: Query service used by the analytics team to query the summaries bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The analytics team ... query that bucket through Athena

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: Console on the Orders API used by support administrators.
processes.source_excerpt: an admin console on the Orders API

data_stores.description: Database holding customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history.

data_stores.description: KMS-encrypted bucket containing summaries written by the nightly batch job.

data_stores.description: KMS-encrypted audit log containing administrator actions; administrators cannot change it.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Customer signs in to the Auth0 identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers sign in to our Auth0 identity provider over HTTPS with TLS 1.3, using a password and MFA

data_flows.name: load web app
data_flows.description: Customer loads the public React single-page web app through CloudFront.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Anyone can load our React single-page web app without signing in

data_flows.name: call Orders API
data_flows.description: The web app calls the internal Orders API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web app calls an internal Orders API in our AWS VPC over HTTPS

data_flows.name: read and write orders
data_flows.description: Orders API reads and writes the Postgres database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The Orders API reads and writes a Postgres database in a private subnet over TLS, with IAM database authentication
data_flows.data_description: Customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history

data_flows.name: authorise payment
data_flows.description: Orders API sends payment authorisation to Stripe.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Payment authorisation goes to Stripe over HTTPS with a secret API key
data_flows.data_description: Payment authorisation; card numbers never reach our systems

data_flows.name: read orders
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job reads at most one day of orders.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A nightly batch job in the VPC reads at most one day of orders over TLS with a read-only database role
data_flows.data_description: At most one day of orders

data_flows.name: write summaries
data_flows.description: Nightly batch job writes summaries to the S3 bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes summaries over HTTPS, with its own IAM role, to a KMS-encrypted S3 bucket

data_flows.name: query summaries
data_flows.description: Analytics team queries the bucket through Athena.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The analytics team, a group of internal analysts, query that bucket through Athena

data_flows.name: read summaries
data_flows.description: Athena reads the S3 bucket over TLS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Athena, which reads it over TLS, with read- only IAM roles

data_flows.name: perform admin actions
data_flows.description: Support administrators use the admin console to refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Through it they refund orders, edit delivery addresses, and look up order history
data_flows.data_description: Refunds, delivery addresses, and order history

data_flows.name: admin console requests
data_flows.description: Admin console requests are handled by the Orders API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: an admin console on the Orders API from a corporate management network over HTTPS

data_flows.name: write audit actions
data_flows.description: Orders API writes each administrator action to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API writes each action over HTTPS, with its IAM role, to a KMS- encrypted CloudWatch Logs audit log

data_flows.name: copy or restore snapshots
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores database snapshots.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore the database snapshots
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy or restore bucket
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the S3 bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore ... the bucket
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

data_flows.name: copy or restore audit log
data_flows.description: Platform team copies or restores the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Only the platform team can copy or restore ... the audit log, through IAM roles with SSO and MFA over HTTPS
data_flows.authentication: IAM roles with SSO and MFA

assumptions.assumption: The React single-page web app is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: The text says anyone can load the app and that CloudFront serves it to the public internet.

assumptions.assumption: The Postgres database's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The database holds customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history.

assumptions.assumption: The S3 bucket's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The bucket holds summaries derived from orders, which are business and customer-related records.

assumptions.assumption: The CloudWatch Logs audit log's contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The audit log contains administrator actions involving orders and delivery addresses.

assumptions.assumption: The database snapshots' contents are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The snapshots are copies or restorations of the Postgres database containing customer and order records.
